images.title: Corners on the line stay
images.purpose: Show that a corner on the mirror line stays put and the other corners swap.
images.composition: One square with its slanting mirror line AC, wide space around it, and one arrow.
images.exact_structure: One square of side 4 cm filled teal #0072B2, corners A top left, B top right, C bottom right, D bottom left. One dashed grey #6B7280 diagonal line from A to C. Corners A and C each circled in amber #E69F00. One reddish purple #CC79A7 double headed arrow between B and D, crossing the line. Exactly 1 square, 1 dashed line, 2 circles, 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a circle or arrow on corner B or D other than the swap arrow
images.takeaway: A corner on the mirror line stays; the others swap sides.
images.description: A teal square with a dashed diagonal AC, corners A and C circled as staying, and a double arrow between B and D showing they swap.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the corners that do not move and the corners that swap.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
